q: How do I book with OneVaya?
a: Send an enquiry, request a quote or build your trip in the Trip Builder. A travel designer reviews your request and sends you a tailored quote. Once you accept, we make the bookings for you.

q: How quickly will I receive a quote?
a: Usually within one working day. Complex or group trips can take a little longer.

q: Can I change my quote before accepting?
a: Yes. Reply to your quote or message us from My OneVaya and we will update it.

q: What does the Trip Builder check?
a: It checks every activity against opening days, real time slots, activity duration, travel time between places and booking cut-offs, and suggests valid times when something does not fit.

q: Is my Trip Builder plan a confirmed booking?
a: No. Your plan is sent as a quote request. Prices and availability are confirmed by your travel designer.

q: How does the AI itinerary suggestion work?
a: Describe your trip and the AI proposes a day-wise plan using only OneVaya's approved experiences. Every suggestion is validated before it is shown, and you can customise it before requesting a quote.

q: Where can I see my invoices?
a: All invoices and payments recorded by OneVaya are shown in My OneVaya under Invoices & payments.

q: Where are my tickets and vouchers?
a: Log in to My OneVaya and open your trip. Flight tickets, hotel vouchers, transfer confirmations and sightseeing tickets can be downloaded there.

q: How do I request a change to my booking?
a: Open the booking in My OneVaya and choose Request change. Your travel designer will reply in the same place.

q: Can you help with my UAE visa?
a: Yes. Our visa assistance team guides you through requirements and documents. Visa decisions are made by the authorities.
